fullPassage: In accordance with fire safety regulations, it is essential to keep all hallways free of personal belongings such as bicycles, boxes, and small furniture. Hallways serve as critical evacuation routes during emergencies, and anything left there could block the way and pose serious safety risks. To ensure the safety of all residents, we request that any personal items placed in the hallways be removed by Monday, April 14th. Please note that not following this may result in penalties. We appreciate your cooperation in maintaining a safe environment.

questions.passage: In accordance with fire safety regulations, it is (A)[essential / optional] to keep all hallways free of personal belongings such as bicycles, boxes, and small furniture. Hallways serve as critical evacuation routes during emergencies, and anything left there could (B)[block / clear] the way and pose serious safety risks. To (C)[ensure / endanger] the safety of all residents, we request that any personal items placed in the hallways be removed by Monday, April 14th. Please note that not following this may result in penalties.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 복도를 비우는 것이 필수적(essential)이고, 물건이 길을 막을(block) 수 있으며, 안전을 보장하기(ensure) 위해 치워달라고 한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① essential — block — ensure: 원문과 일치
❌ ② optional(선택적) — endanger(위험에 빠뜨리다): (A)(C) 반의어
❌ ③ clear(치우다) — endanger: (B)(C) 반의어
❌ ④ optional — clear — ensure: (A)(B) 반의어

questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 소방 안전 규정(regulations), 대피(evacuation) 경로, 협조(cooperation)에 감사.
det.analysis:
✅ ② regulations — evacuation — cooperation: 원문 일치
❌ ① suggestions: 약한 의미
❌ ③ celebration/competition: 반의어
❌ ④ suggestions/celebration: 이중 오류

questions.passage: In accordance with fire safety regulations, it is essential to keep all hallways (A)[free / full] of personal belongings such as bicycles, boxes, and small furniture. Hallways serve as critical evacuation routes during emergencies, and anything left there could block the way and (B)[pose / eliminate] serious safety risks. Please note that not following this may result in (C)[penalties / rewards].
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 소지품 없이(free), 위험을 초래(pose), 벌금(penalties).
det.analysis:
✅ ③ free — pose — penalties: 원문 일치
❌ ① full/rewards: 반의어
❌ ② eliminate(제거): pose의 반의어
❌ ④ 전부 반의어

questions.passage: In accordance with fire safety regulations, it is essential to keep all hallways ①<u>free</u> of personal belongings such as bicycles, boxes, and small furniture. Hallways serve as critical evacuation routes during emergencies, and anything left there could ②<u>block</u> the way and pose serious safety ③<u>risks</u>. To ensure the safety of all residents, we request that any personal items placed in the hallways be ④<u>retained</u> by Monday, April 14th.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ④ retained(보관하다) → removed(치우다): 물품을 '보관'이 아니라 '치워야' 한다.
det.analysis:
❌ ④ retained(보관하다): 원문은 removed(치우다)
✅ ① free(없는): 원문 일치
✅ ② block(막다): 원문 일치
✅ ③ risks(위험): 원문 일치

Please note that not following this may result in ③<u>penalties</u>. We ④<u>appreciate</u> your cooperation in maintaining a safe environment.

det.analysis:
❌ ② endanger: 원문은 ensure(보장하다)
✅ ① belongings: 원문 일치
✅ ③ penalties: 원문 일치
✅ ④ appreciate: 원문 일치
